lines: Round 18 so far: motion 4, the app 8, the interface 7; one machine check red (the phone screen); the jury and the gate are still open
Polish round 1 is closed on main with the hand, the cut, the table and the glass in; the liquid and the storm were not merged because their stills were worse than the kept ones
Polish round 2, the last, started 17:46 with seven fresh build agents; they stop at 20:50

pictures.caption: Round 18, the phone screen as judged (390 by 844, the build before polish round 1): the base runs off both sides. Machine check M1 is red for it and the app critic called it major. It is the first job of the interface agent in round 2.

Polish round 1's glass, now on main: summer at rest at the final tier, native crops where it changed most, this morning's kept still left, main right. The thick blue-white ring and the hard white blade gave way to a thin edge and a soft reflection; a thin dark outline is left and is on round 2's list.

Round 18, the app's own shake from winter to spring, frames 126 to 170, four apart, on the build before polish round 1: the base and the table cut to spring in one step while the globe is still in the air. The motion critic called it severe (score 4).
The sounds kept so far: 7 of 25 (glass clink, sound-on, tick, lift, spring's shake and air, summer's air). Fall's three cues ran out of takes at 17:37 with none kept.
